limits: Pure offline engineering controls on synthetic ledgers and synthetic SPEC-048 reservation receipts. No host, model, paid route, file, clock or network access, and no native cost, quota or invoice was observed: every value in the tests is a deterministic double. Evidence hashes on observed measurements are checked for shape only; binding them to real invoices, quota readings or SPEC-048 observations is the caller's responsibility. Shared-cost rules are limited to equal split and unallocated; per-arm sensitivity bounds cover allocation and unknowns only, not measurement error. A missing phase is not detectable beyond the listed phases without entries, the cleanup requirement for reserved attempts and the attempts-without-cost check. A journal overrun is judged per attempt under the declared allocation, not against the combined reservations. Numeric time/quota caps are deferred per the T002 D2 founder decision and none is applied; additional cash is capped at EUR 0. An unblocked report is not an economic or utility acceptance. Pre-PR reviews (code-review, code-review-and-quality, code-simplification) were run by Claude subagents and are not independent Luna review.
outcome: Reservations reconcile against setup, context, proposal, probe, retry, selection, reflection, verification, recovery, review and cleanup costs; unknown or missing measurements stay unknown (never zero) with known lower bounds; shared costs carry explicit equal/unallocated rules and lower/point/upper sensitivity bounds; quota and cash are separate dimensions with exact unit conversion; every registered unit, refusal, failure and ungraded attempt stays in the per-arm denominators; unknown cash, any observed additional cash, open or missing reservations, journal overruns, unaccounted cleanup and attempts without cost entries block an economic claim with fixed reason codes.
